Maya Chen: Heads-up — customer 'GlobalBank' wants an air-gapped on‑prem POC. They asked for packaging details, upgrade cadence, and any blockers. Need answers for exec review on Thu.
Dan Rivera: Got it. Which model family/size are they planning to run? quantized or fp16?
Maya Chen: They prefer quantized to save RAM. Target hardware: 2x A10G or 4x T4 equivalent. Avg call ~512 tokens, bursty, ~60 qps peak.
Dan Rivera: OK. I'll produce a compatibility matrix (OS, driver, CUDA, cuDNN, glibc, kernel) and call out tested model variants.
A.J. Patel: Packaging constraints from infra side:
- Offline bundle must contain runtime, model weights, deterministic install script, and SHA256 checksums
- Bundles signed with our RSA key; operator verifies signature before install
- Delta updates supported via signed patch archives, applied manually by site ops
Sasha Gomez: Security flags:
- Customer requires zero outbound telemetry and no call-home
- Offline activation via signed license file only (no PKI handshake to our cloud)
- Need a short threat-model doc and a CVE/patch SLA for the POC
Kelly Park: Legal check: POC licensing for on‑prem usually uses a time‑limited trial agreement + standard EULA. Will confirm indemnity wording around redistributed quantized weights.
deploy-bot: Build pipeline triggered: sales/airgap-poc #4821
Dan Rivera: Draft compat matrix will include: OS matrix, minimum kernel, nvidia-driver versions, CUDA/cuDNN combos, and model quantization format. I'll attach sample after initial test.
Maya Chen: Timeline: can we get a minimal bundle prototype by EOD Wed? Exec sync Thu morning.
Dan Rivera: EOD Wed is tight given validation matrix. Aiming for Thu 09:00 delivery. Minimal checklist below:
```
- bundle-offline-v1.tar.gz
- bundle-offline-v1.tar.gz.sha256
- license_signed.json
- install-offline.sh (bash)
- README-offline.md (install & rollback steps)
```
A.J. Patel: Additional ops notes: offline installer will create a local keystore for license sigs, supports HSM path if customer wants. Delta update tool is `rw-updater` (operator-run).
Sasha Gomez: For cadence: recommend quarterly security patch windows for noncritical fixes, plus a documented emergency CVE hotfix workflow (signed hotfix delivered out-of-band). I'll draft a 1‑page security memo.
Maya Chen: Pricing question from customer: 90‑day POC on 2 GPUs — do we have standard POC discounts?
Kelly Park: Sales practice: typically 50% off on Dedicated for first 90 days; will confirm exact numbers with pricing ops. Also will prepare a sample POC SOW snippet.
Dan Rivera: Quick technical blocker to flag: some older enterprise RHEL kernels require a newer glibc for our runtime. Will call out unsupported combos in the matrix.
Maya Chen: OK next steps:
- Dan: compat matrix + minimal bundle prototype
- A.J.: sign/build flow + `rw-updater` doc
- Sasha: 1pg security memo + recommended patch cadence
- Kelly: pricing confirmation + POC SOW language
Target sync/demo: Thu 11:00 (customer execs 12:00 their timezone)
Maya Chen: tagging @dan.rivera @aj.patel @sasha.gomez @kelly.park — please ack :thumbsup:
Dan Rivera: Ack.
A.J. Patel: Ack.
Sasha Gomez: Ack, I'll start the memo.
Kelly Park: Ack, looping legal/pricing.
